name: banking_routing
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about?

card_payment_not_recognised.description: A card payment on the statement that the customer does not recognise or did not make
examples: Why is there an uknown charge showing on my account?

cash_withdrawal_not_recognised.description: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise
examples: I see non-received cash in my app.

criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up

unknown_transfer_or_payment_source.description: A specific transaction or payment on the account that the customer did not make and does not recognise (possible fraud)
examples: there is money in my account that i didnt put there

cancel_card_transaction.description: Customer wants to cancel or stop a transaction or purchase made with their card (not a bank transfer they sent)
examples: I need to cancel a transaction on my debit card.

criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks the card or card details were stolen, cloned, hacked or used by someone else

lost_or_stolen_card.description: Card lost or stolen, need to block/freeze it, or a lost card that was later found
examples: A fee shouldn't apply to me if my card was stolen.

pin_blocked.description: Customer forgot their card PIN, or the PIN is rejected or blocked after too many wrong attempts; unblocking the PIN
examples: I forgot my PIN number.
I was removing a dollar amount from my account and now don't have access to my card.

criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten app passcode or password / locked out of the app / can't log in

lost_or_stolen_phone.description: Phone with the banking app lost or stolen; protecting the account after losing the phone
examples: phone is at a hotel, can i still use app

criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund or to dispute a charge for a purchase (e.g. goods not received), or asks how the refund process works
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant has not appeared on the account yet
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate charge

wrong_amount_of_cash_received.description: ATM gave less cash than requested or than was debited
examples: I haven't received my cash yet.
In a recent withdrawal I received less cash than I expected to receive.  Did someone make an error with the exchange rate?
I could not get the cash I wanted
Do any of your machines provide cash from my home country? I don't have any money on me and I'm on holiday so I'm concerned.

reverted_card_payment.description: A card payment was reversed, returned or cancelled (by the app, bank or merchant) and money came back; a payment that cannot be found
examples: I have cancelled payments to this card.
How come I can't find my payment?
I made a payment but the app cancelled it.
My payment was terminated

criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: New card has not arrived yet / tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options
criteria.card_linking: Linking an existing card to the app / adding a found or new card into the app
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card suddenly not working at all
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon, getting a replacement card for expiry
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / will merchants accept it
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical plastic card
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/spare card for the account
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or a virtual card not working
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Disposable virtual cards: getting one, limits, or one being rejected

visa_or_mastercard.description: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard / choosing card network
examples: I have a Visa and Mastercard, can I use these?
Can I choose what card I can use

apple_pay_or_google_pay.description: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the card, including topping up through them
examples: What currencies does google pay top up accept?

criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card can be used at
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN to a new one
criteria.get_pin: Where to find, get or receive the PIN of a new card; PIN not received yet

declined_card_payment.description: A card payment in a shop or online was declined
examples: I've made more than one attempt to make a purchase and the card keeps getting declined. Why do you keep denying my transfers?
I'm having issues with my card. You guys keep declining it for some reason. I haven't had any issues up until this point.

pending_card_payment.description: A payment (card purchase) is still pending or taking long to go through
examples: What's taking so long for this payment to go through?

criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel or reverse a transfer or payment the customer made, including one sent to the wrong account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient has not received money the customer sent
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.pending_transfer: An outgoing transfer is stuck pending
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A transfer failed, was declined or not allowed
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary / payee is not allowed

receiving_money.description: How to receive money or a salary into the account
examples: Is there any way to get my salary in a different currency?

criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into my own account from another bank
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: Incoming bank transfer not showing in balance yet
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited cheque or cash not showing in balance yet

transaction_receipt.description: Receipt, proof or record of a transfer or money transaction the customer made
examples: I did a money transaction and dont have a receipt

criteria.top_up_methods: How to top up / add money: by card, bank transfer, cash, cheque, apps
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up or using auto top-up
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up with a code/card verification

examples: Help! My card isn't working at the ATM and I know I used the right PIN. Trying to get my money.

pending_cash_withdrawal.description: An ATM cash withdrawal is still pending, or the balance looks wrong after an ATM withdrawal
examples: My balance is not what I thought it was following an ATM withdrawal

criteria.transfer_with_credit_card: Using a credit card to transfer or add money
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / current rates
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad

wrong_exchange_rate_cash_withdrawal.description: Wrong exchange rate applied when withdrawing cash from an ATM abroad
examples: When I received my cash; they had my exchange rate incorrect.

criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app

supported_cards_and_currencies.description: Which card types (e.g. American Express) and currencies can be used or are accepted
examples: Can I use American Express?

criteria.supported_currencies: Which fiat currencies are supported / holding different currencies

card_payment_fee_charged.description: A fee charged on a card payment (e.g. a purchase abroad), or a fee the customer thinks should not apply
examples: I received a fee I should not have.

transfer_fee_charged.description: Fee charged for sending a transfer or for receiving money; a transfer arrived with less than the amount sent
examples: Do I get charged if I am receiving money?
I made a transfer and the receiver said an amount was received, but less than the right amount.

criteria.top_up_charge: Fees for topping up by card or bank transfer

extra_charge_on_statement.description: An unexplained extra charge (e.g. a small £1 charge) on the statement that the customer questions
examples: There is a pending 1£ charge on my statement.  I haven't purchased anything for 1£.  Why is it on my statement?

criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing / app can't verify me

verify_source_of_funds.description: Source of funds: where the money in my account comes from, who is giving me my money, proving the source of funds
examples: What information do I need to see my source of money?
Who is giving me my money?
Where can I find out where my funds came from?

account_security_info.description: General questions about how the account and the customer's money are kept safe and protected
examples: What kind of security protects my money?

criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account / accounts for children

country_support.description: Which countries the service or account is available in
examples: How do I sign up for a card if I'm in America?

criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
